naming.future_candidates: STRATEGY_V2_HYPOTHESIS_NNN (zero-padded, never reused; a parameter change after a validation look = new ID)

entry_schema.status: SPECIFIED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED | IMPLEMENTED | DEVELOPMENT_REVIEWED | FROZEN | VALIDATION_VIEWED | REJECTED_AT_DEVELOPMENT | REJECTED_AT_VALIDATION | FORWARD_PAPER | RETIRED (legacy lowercase 'frozen' = FROZEN)
entry_schema.description: what the hypothesis is and why (written BEFORE looking at validation)
entry_schema.code_commit: git commit hash of the exact code evaluated (clean tree)
entry_schema.parameters: object: every parameter that differs from production defaults, plus the ones under test
entry_schema.development_result: reference to output file + headline metrics (DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE)
entry_schema.frozen_date: YYYY-MM-DD: date code + parameters were frozen; required before any validation look
entry_schema.validation_viewed_at: ISO timestamp of the single validation look, or null
entry_schema.validation_viewed_before_parameter_chang: bool: true means parameters were changed after viewing validation -> this ID's validation is contaminated
entry_schema.validation_result: reference + headline metrics (VALIDATION EVIDENCE), or null
entry_schema.known_period_result: optional reference (KNOWN/CONTAMINATED EVIDENCE; never used for selection)
entry_schema.spec_document: path to the pre-registration document (rules, constants, gates)
entry_schema.preregistered_gates: development/validation gates recorded before any result
entry_schema.review_decisions: design questions settled before implementation (date + decisions); part of the frozen spec

preregistered_gates.d6_definition: P_s = sum realized_pnl of completed trades per symbol; pool = sum max(P_s,0); pass iff pool > 0 and max(max(P_s,0)/pool) <= 0.50 (exact, no rounding); pool == 0 -> FAIL (undefined, empty positive pool)

entries.notes: Motivated by diagnostics on the KNOWN/CONTAMINATED period, which therefore provides no evidence for it. Any change after development review -> new ID. Development gate FAILED on 2026-09-24 (D1, D2, D4, D5, D6); validation never run; H001 is closed.
